verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only documents APIs for sending data INTO Customer.io (Track API, Pipelines API, suppression via events) and MCP-based automation reads, but contains no mention of a bulk data export, audience/contact export tool, or open-format download of engagement history and suppression lists. No self-serve export capability is evidenced anywhere in the pack. Missing for 10: any documentation of an export/download feature, open-format (CSV/JSON) audience export, or bulk API read endpoint for full contact/tag/engagement/suppression data.
